snippet.title: Winds of Arcana: Ruination - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201910/Winds_Of_Arcana_Ruination/

We are incredibly thrilled to share our new trailer for “Winds of Arcana: Ruination”, featuring never before seen gameplay, including some ferocious bosses! 

With our launch just around the corner, we are immensely proud of all the hard work the team has poured into this game over the past five years.  It won’t be long now before you can dig into the game yourself! 

Until then, please do try our updated demo if you haven’t already, and don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam!

#Metroidvania #Indiegame #GameDev #Platformer #Gaming
